_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + near_eastern (akkadian) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (goidelic / Gaelic register: ri/tuath/cland/fine, mac-/ua- patronymics, dun/rath/cathair toponyms, broad vs slender consonants and initial mutation, -an/-in diminutives)
blend.overlay: near_eastern (akkadian: the alu/bit-ili river-cities, the sangu temple-priesthood, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals, root-based grammar)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Galatian-style Gaelic war-aristocracy (a ri and his sworn cland) enthroned over the Akkadian temple-cities of the Two Rivers: the migrant war-clans rule from their dun-forts, the scribal-priestly alu-city endures and serves beneath. This INVERTS Ashurheim's Germanic lean (Celtic backbone here, not Germanic).

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 Albawyn (Celtic) x BASE_03 Shinarur (Mesopotamian). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Mesopotamian base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Shinarwyn is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Galatian-style Celtic migration - Gaelic war-clans that crossed into the Two Rivers and set themselves up as kings over the Akkadian temple-cities (a Celtic warrior-aristocracy over a Mesopotamian river-city substrate; 'Shinar's-fort'). Backbone = Celtic (goidelic/Gaelic: the ruling war-clans, the ri/tuath/cland register, the mac-/ua- patronymics, the dun-and-rath land); overlay/substrate = Akkadian (the alu-cities, the bit-ili temples, the scribal populace, the construct-chain toponyms). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic and Akkadian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents - the CELTIC theonym_set reflexes PRIMARY (Toran, Orlann, Gaian), the Akkadian morphs SECONDARY (Tullaru, Urlandu, Gayandu), never real gods. Register choice: Celtic-base hybrids default to the GOIDELIC/Gaelic reflexes (mac-/ua-, dun/rath, ri/tuath); Brythald (HYB_01) is the Germanic-leaning Anglo-Saxon special case. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH; the goidelic conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. No approved foreign term applies (no Mesopotamian term on the approved list), so display titles are English only. Deities are the canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.

phonology.palette: Goidelic Celtic backbone - initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), broad vs slender consonants, root-initial stress, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data), -an/-in diminutives - meeting an Akkadian overlay: emphatic and guttural consonants (q, kh, h, ', sh, ts), triconsonantal roots, a/i/u vowels, -u/-um/-tu endings. Per the CSV: liquid consonants (the broad/slender l, r, n of the Gaelic stock) mixed with emphatic gutturals (the Akkadian q/kh/'); grammar is VSO with root-based initial mutations (the Goidelic verb-first order carried over an Akkadian construct-chain substrate). Theophoric on the Gaelic reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Akkadian construct variants (Tullaru-, Urlandu-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; Gaelic mutation-driven clusters and the broad-slender contrast meeting Akkadian construct-chains and mimation -um; root-initial stress with an Akkadian penultimate pull; dun-/rath- Gaelic compounds over Bit-/Dur-/Kar- construct toponyms.

sound_changes: Akkadian emphatics/gutturals soften into the Goidelic inventory: q>c, emphatic-s/ts>s, kh>ch, glottal-stop>0 (Goidelic has no q/emphatics)
Akkadian case-vowels and mimation drop or take a Goidelic ending: final -u/-um/-tu>0, or a short root takes Goidelic -an/-ach (-tu/-du often lenite to -h)
Goidelic lenition and the broad/slender contrast applied across every root (c>ch, b>bh/v, t>th, d>dh between vowels); liquids l/r/n carry the broad-slender colour
Goidelic root-initial stress on all words; Goidelic CV/CVC syllable shape; Akkadian penultimate pull surfaces only in long construct-toponyms
retain Goidelic broad/slender l-r-n, the slender c/ch, and the Akkadian sh; very short Akkadian roots take a Goidelic -an/-ach to sit in the Gaelic mouth
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/river/material/staple words from Akkadian roots (the alu-city substrate works the soil: naru>nar, qishtu>cisht, she'u>shean); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the ruling war-clans: mor, dubh, ard, the directionals); every root then filtered to one Goidelic-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Akkadian land/material/staple roots + Goidelic rule/kin/quality roots, all run through one Goidelic-shaped sound-law (lenition, broad/slender, root-initial stress, Akkadian -u/-um/-tu dropped or Gaelicized to -an/-ach); portmanteaus mark the blended bloodline and the shared institutions.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Gaelic ruling clans keep Mac- (son of) / Ua- (descendant of) patronymics and the fine/cland kin-group; the Akkadian populace keep the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the throne fuses both - a ri who also carries a Bit- house-name over the conquered cities.
morphology.compounding_rule: Gaelic feature-compound ([quality](stem) + element: Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) layered over Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god]): the capital Dun-Shinar (Shinar's-fort), Dur-Conn (fort of the Conn-cland), Bit-Tullaru (the temple-city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Gaelic war-aristocracy over the Akkadian temple-cities: the ri and his cland-kin at the crown, the tigerna-lords over the alu-cities, the flaith-nobles sworn to the war-host; the sangu-priesthood and the scribal ekallu serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Goidelic ladder, ascending, with the Akkadian substrate co-titles beneath. Flaith (noble-lord) barony; Criche-tigerna (border-lord) march; Tigerna (lord) county; Toisech (chieftain/leader) duchy; Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom; Ard-ri (high king) empire. The conquered cities keep their Akkadian shaknu (governor) and sangu (priest) beneath the Gaelic crown. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage) stand outside the ladder, as does the Akkadian scribal shatammu. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Akkadian registers (allowed).
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Gaelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac-/Ua- patronymic or fine/cland; the Akkadian populace carry a theophoric given name + mar- patronymic; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Gaelic war-aristocracy keep Goidelic names (Conn-, Niall-, Bran-, with Mac-/Ua- patronymics and the cland); the Akkadian city-folk keep theophoric names (X-iddina, Warad-X) on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Gaelic devotional on the morphed god-reflexes (Mael-Toran, devotee of Toran; Gilla-Orlann, servant of Orlann); Akkadian devotional constructs: Warad-Tullaru (servant of Tullaru), Tullaru-iddina (Tullaru-gave-me).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic (Goidelic) reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set, reflexed through Insular-Celtic phonology), Akkadian variants SECONDARY (the family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs), never real Celtic/Mesopotamian gods. All three alignments: the Gaelic war-oath and druid-lore order meets the Akkadian law-stele and temple tradition.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Celtic; Akk Itarnu) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Akk Tullaru) - the sun and justice

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan foremost, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the fomori (Gaelic demon-host) or -lemnu (Akkadian evil), warded; the war-oath and the law-stele bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the sinser-heroes of the ruling cland) and the city-spirits of the bit-ili; the great powers invoked at the nemed-grove and the temple situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eternan - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fomori (Gaelic demon-host) or -lemnu (Akkadian evil), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Akk Marakshu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Akk Bakidu-lemnu); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Gaelic sacred grove) or Bit-ili (Akkadian god-house) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru'; the Gaelic substrate keeps Cill- (church/cell): 'Cill-Toran'.
religion.saints_pattern: the sinser (the deified war-dead of the ruling cland) and the deified law-givers of the cities, honored at the carn (cairn), the nemed-grove and the ziggurat.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-wheel over a crossed sword and law-stele
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron sword crossed with the city-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the alluvial field beneath the ziggurat
